usedFor: StoreHippo holds your store orders, and Zoom runs the webinar when “New Order” runs “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A customer who orders a webinar seat is registered for it automatically.

watchOut: “User Updated” fires on every change, so the same customer can reach “Register Attendee for Webinar” again.
